purpose: Validate a real same-request vertical slice with NeuralRx in a separate persistent MPS process, CUDA-IPC payloads, local LDPC/CRC, and no client lifecycle churn during the RAN epoch.

endpoint.transport: same-device CUDA IPC payload; project-root mmap doorbells
endpoint.payload: request-specific rx_slot and channel estimate; request-specific output LLR
endpoint.lifecycle: create before warmup, keep persistent for all 10000 releases, terminate only after the final release

interpretation_limit: Passing validates the clean-channel separate-process vertical slice under this A100/MPS/D35 contract. It does not yet validate natural NeuralRx failures, physical overrun recovery, or a mathematical hard deadline.
